cuts.placeText: an auction hall — rows of folding chairs, a raised wooden podium, a number paddle stand and hanging lamps
cuts.scene: she is an auctioneer standing at the podium with her hands folded, waiting for the next bid
cuts.outfit: an auctioneer look fitted to her body — a fitted sleeveless vest over a collared blouse and a short pencil skirt, bare arms and legs, a thin red tie
